name: judge-fr-eu
description: Judge FR/UE — independent fork of Claude for Legal (Anthropic). Technical isolation 0.1.0; French hiring pilot 0.2.1 client-tested on fixtures (LIV-001 lot); contract orientation COM-001 0.2.0 under validation; other inherited legal tasks not adapted.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-commercial-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.2.2 : orientation contractuelle France/UE sans profil obligatoire (COM-001) ; domaine, rôle achat/vente, tâche, pièces et questions utiles. Revues, registres et agents hérités non adaptés ; aucune branche aval automatique. Validation client/utilisateur à compléter.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-privacy-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Triages processing activities, generates PIAs, reviews DPAs as controller or processor, drafts DSAR responses within statutory timelines, and monitors policy drift against practice.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-product-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Reviews product launches against your risk calibration, answers 'is this a problem?' questions in minutes, checks marketing copy for claims that need substantiation, and flags upcoming launches that need legal eyes before anyone asks.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-corporate-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Runs M&A diligence at scale with cited tabular review, builds disclosure schedules and closing checklists, drafts board consents and minutes in house format, and tracks entity compliance deadlines across jurisdictions.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-employment-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.3.5 : hiring-review pour comprendre une offre ou un contrat salarié privé en France (CDI, contrôles CDD ciblés) et worker-classification pour qualifier une relation de travail proposée avant exécution, sans choix automatique du statut. Recettes sur pièces fictives, lecteur non indépendant ; autres tâches héritées non adaptées.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-regulatory-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Watches regulatory feeds, diffs new rules against your policy library, tracks comment deadlines and open gaps, and writes the digest your team reads Monday morning.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-ai-governance-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Triages proposed AI use cases against your registry, runs impact assessments across the regimes in scope, reviews vendor AI terms for training-on-data and liability gaps, and keeps your AI policy current with practice.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-litigation-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Manages the litigation portfolio — matters, deadlines, holds, demands, outside counsel — and does the work: claim charts (patent and civil), chronologies, depo prep, privilege logs, brief drafting. Adapts to how you work litigation: in-house, firm, or solo.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-law-student
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Drills Socratically, briefs cases, builds outlines, runs bar prep sessions tuned to your jurisdiction, grades IRAC practice, and plans the study schedule — without ever writing it for you.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-legal-builder-hub
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Finds, evaluates, and installs community legal skills — with a security review gate before anything lands in your environment.

plugins.name: judge-fr-eu-ip-legal
plugins.description: Judge FR/UE 0.1.2: technical isolation; legal adaptation pending. Runs first-pass trademark clearance and freedom-to-operate triage, screens invention disclosures for initial patentability, drafts and triages cease-and-desist letters and DMCA takedowns (send and respond), checks open source compliance, reviews IP clauses, and tracks registrations and renewal deadlines.
